value.rationale: This sharp, exact model-specific physicality boundary addresses the reported central creation of distillability from separable or PPT inputs in a natural six-Kraus finite-temperature model; its quantitative trace defect explains how an entanglement diagnostic may become spuriously positive outside its normalization premises. The source reports a dramatic physical transition past this boundary. The value is in the exact identification of a substantive published interpretation boundary, not in claiming general PPT preservation as a new theorem.
